evals.prompt: Critical workflows pass in a sandbox, migration reconciliation is complete, and runbooks exist.

expectations.text: Produces an evidence-backed approval-with-limits or approval decision.

evals.prompt: A partner-isolation test is blocked because its fixture is unavailable.

expectations.text: Blocks unconditional approval and records owner and next test.

evals.prompt: Reviewers agree but rollback rehearsal was not run.

expectations.text: Rejects agreement as proof and blocks release.
